title: After the Tenno Sho (Autumn) - Downpour of Emotions

text_block_list.text: Give it your all! Silence Suzukaaa!!

……I can hear it. I can feel it. The cheers 
that ride on the breeze, all these memories 
are bursting into me ——
choice_data_list: (Then does that mean, Stay Gold too…)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
————Stay with me until the very end! 
Suzuka! !

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold has appeared!!! Stay Gold 
has taken the lead! Stay Gold!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold is the winner!!! On this golden 
Sunday, the heroine is Stay Gold!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I think I did it…… I overcame that fated 
turning point……

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhhhhhhh!! What a race!! Stay Gold, Silence Suzuka, they're all amazing……!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I seriously feel like I'm gonna cry……! 
Stay Gold, congratsss!!!

An unstoppable force of joy was overflowing 
through my heart, to the point where 
everything became blurry… Though, for one 
thing in particular ——

The exact moment Stay Gold reached the 
finish line, I heard it, I felt it.

That a certain crucial, irreversible event 
had crumbled away without a trace.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
……I wasn't able to even reach that 
scenery……

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ……So why do I feel like this, this warmth…?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka!!!! How vexing!!! 
You did so well!!!

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You displayed such a wonderful 
performance today!!! I'll be cheering 
you on in the next one for sure!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That was a great race. Your running was 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Let's do this again. Our next race 
will be even better than this one.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That was all I had to say. 
—— See ya next time.

With that, Stay Gold's decisive battle in 
the Autumn Tenno Sho comes to an end.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……I think it'd be good to stop here 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
We've just managed to overtake a great 
storm. We'll need some time to broaden 
our map, right?

I haven't made any decisions for Stay Gold's 
next race yet, though ——

It's as she says, for now let's take a break 
and stop for a while. With fresh eyes, we 
can confirm what will come next.

Where we stand right now, and where 
our next destination should be.
